title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount Corporation d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Saugus).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Jr., Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-18)
